summary.intent: Generate executable PLAN.md files for Phase 21 (BYO-IPFS Node Support) using the GSD plan-phase workflow with research, planning, and verification stages.
summary.outcome: Successfully created 6 PLAN.md files for Phase 21 across the planning pipeline, with existing research, validation strategy, and UI-SPEC artifacts all reused without regeneration.

repo: Phase 21 is 'BYO-IPFS Node Support' — a phase with frontend indicators requiring a UI-SPEC before planning
The GSD workflow stores phase artifacts in .planning/phases/{padded_phase}-{slug}/ with prefixed filenames (21-CONTEXT.md, 21-RESEARCH.md, 21-UI-SPEC.md, 21-VALIDATION.md)
Phase 21 had all prerequisite artifacts already in place: CONTEXT.md, RESEARCH.md, UI-SPEC.md, and VALIDATION.md — planning could proceed directly
Plans are numbered sequentially: 21-01-PLAN.md through 21-06-PLAN.md (6 plans total)
workflow: The plan-phase workflow short-circuits research when RESEARCH.md already exists and no --research flag is provided
The UI Design Contract Gate checks for frontend keywords in the phase description and blocks planning if no UI-SPEC exists
Nyquist validation artifacts (VALIDATION.md) are checked before spawning the planner — missing artifacts prompt the user to re-research or disable Nyquist
The gsd-planner agent also updates ROADMAP.md as part of the planning output
